title: Summa Theologiae I, question 2 · Bible Guide
heading: Summa Theologiae I, question 2
paragraph: Read the objections as well as the replies. Aquinas argues from effects to God; our contingency outline is an introductory reconstruction, not a quotation of his Five Ways. Limited use: causation and dependence in I, q.2, a.3, alongside Sproul. This does not endorse Aquinas's account of justification, merit or ecclesial authority.
